ValidationRule.description: Limits the Billing Phone to 16 characters
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias<> "sconn",
LEN(PHONE_NUMBER__c) > 16,
OR( $RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany", $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Montreal", $RecordType.Name = "SAP Asia", $RecordType.Name = "S4 - Boulder", $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Salem/MIA" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Phone can only be up to 16 characters.
